identity: R119 foundations author proof diagnostic; not independently preregistered and not primary numerical evidence
reconstruction_basis: Filesystem birth/modify timestamps plus the tool-reported elapsed values retained in the conversation. Process launch/exit clocks were not explicitly instrumented.

fraction_stdout_check.bounds_meaning: After the verifier script was created and before the subsequent standalone LaTeX harness was created.

fraction_saved_json_check.bounds_meaning: After harness creation and before the first subsequent pdflatex log was created.
fraction_saved_json_check.file_window_caveat: These two precise timestamps bound JSON-writing activity, not the separately uninstrumented full process launch/exit.

standalone_document_build.bounds_meaning: After preceding verifier output and before the manifest written after the final successful compile returned.
standalone_document_build.first_pass_timing_caveat: The first process yielded while generating fonts; its exact total runtime was not retained by a process-level clock. The later completion poll is not its total elapsed time.
standalone_document_build.scope_caveat: The approximately four-minute activity window includes editing and review gaps. It must not be reported as uninterrupted CPU use or summed with the short command runtimes. No Econometrica integrated build or CI run is asserted here.

overlap_policy: Use the conservative outer windows to screen overlap with benchmark clocks. If overlap cannot be excluded, retain it in the execution ledger instead of assuming these proof diagnostics were computationally free.
